item.description: ### Fixed - **Your phone reconnects after the Mac's listener hiccups.** If the connection your phone uses failed to start (most often right after regenerating the pairing QR code), it stayed down until you turned the companion off and on or restarted Perch. It now retries on its own, on the same port first. - **An approval is never shown as "Allowed" when nothing received it.** If the agent's hook process died while waiting (an interrupted run, a closed OpenCode session), Perch kept offering Allow/Deny and reported a tap as delivered while the agent sat at its own prompt. The request now clears as soon as the hook goes away, and the log says so. - **A tap that arrives too late is told what happened.** Answering from a phone notification after the request was already settled on the Mac or by the timeout now tells you it was already answered, instead of going silent.
